further amended through First Amendment dated 30th August, 2022 (collectively referred to as the

"Tenancy Agreement") is made and entered into at Lahore on this
WHEREAS

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1

The Second Amendment shall come into force on 1st June, 2023 ("Effective Date").

2.

Pursuant to Clause 1.2 of the Tenancy Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to
further extend the term of the Tenancy Agreement for a period of one (3) years
commencing from the Effective Date and ending on 31st May, 2026 ("Extended Term").

3.

The Parties agree that the monthly rent of the Rented Premises is hereby increased by
twenty-five percent (25%). Accordingly, the monthly rent payable by the Tenant to the
Landlord for the Rented Premises during the Extended Term shall be Rs. 605,000 (Rupees
Six Hundred Five Thousand) per month inclusive of all applicable taxes and maintenance
charges ("Monthly Rent'). Now Monthly Rent is Rs.151 Per Sq. Ft. For the avoidance of
doubt, the next rental increment of 25% shall be applicable with effect from 0Vt June 2026.

4.

This Second Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Tenancy Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Tenancy Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and
shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the
event of any conflict, the terms of this Second Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting
term in the Tenancy Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Tenancy Agreement shall bear the same
meaning in this Second Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7.

This Second Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together
shall constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this Second Amendment, having
fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of
witnesses.
